text.abstract: Built the yolo-twice monorepo under code/: an engine daemon on 127.0.0.1:9656 ingests Claude Code JSONL into a committed per-session .yolo-twice folder, and a React UI links a timeline, reader, filter bar and graph through a short deep-link URL with follow mode. To keep the repo portable and private, paths were rewritten to $PROJECT, ~ and <user>, the project index and cursors moved to a gitignored cache, and resume now rebuilds the transcript and runs claude --resume <file> --fork-session. Claude summaries had silently fallen back to raw text because --bare skipped the login, so switching to disableAllHooks fixed them; 57 tests pass, the Pages deck is live, and pasted-image capture into the repo and UI was in progress at the end.
